semiconductor_relevance: High — XAVIS Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced X-ray inspection systems for semiconductor applications.
summary: XAVIS Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced X-ray inspection systems, focusing on defect detection and particle contamination in semiconductor chips and electronic components. The company holds a leading market position in Korea and exports its solutions globally, enhancing product quality and safety in various sectors.

regional_presence.Korea: XAVIS has achieved the number one market share in Korea since 2013.
